<!--- Provide a general summary of your changes in the Title above -->

#### Description
The creation of `VolumeRenkoConsolidator` allow consolidation by constant volume bar.
(accidental closed #6854)

#### Related Issue
closes #3754
continuation of #6804, #6854

#### Motivation and Context
Current consolidators cannot create constant volume bar.

#### Requires Documentation Change
Additional section needed in https://www.quantconnect.com/docs/v2/writing-algorithms/consolidating-data/consolidator-types

#### How Has This Been Tested?
Added unit tests, following the style of `ClassicRenkoConsolidator`, and regression algorithms, following the style of `ClassicRenkoConsolidator`.

issue_context.title: Value Consolidator
issue_context.body:
<!--- This template provides sections for bugs and features. Please delete any irrelevant sections before submitting -->

#### Expected Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the behavior you expect to see for your case. -->
Value Consolidator, for Volume and Dollar Bars as described in the book Advances in Financial Machine Learning, and as implemented by mlfinlab:

https://www.quantconnect.com/forum/discussion/5853/mlfinlab-python-package-released-advances-in-financial-machine-learning/ 

#### Actual Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the actual behavior for your case. -->

Discussion forum replies suggest RenkoConsolidator. However, RenkoBars do not accumulate value of previous bars.

Wanted:

```
bars = []
data = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
total = 0
bar = { 'open': 0, 'close': 0, 'high': 0, 'low': 0}
for d in data:
    total += d
    if total < threshold:
        if bar['open'] == 0:
            bar['open'] = d
        ...
    else:
        bar['close'] == d
        bars.append(bar)
        total = 0
        bar =  { 'open': 0, 'close': 0, 'high': 0, 'low': 0}
```
